LESSON: HADITH ON PLANTING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on dressing (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the lea
Topic 2.3: Hadith on planting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on planting. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What are the dangers of cutting down trees?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
2. plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah
3. appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HADITH ON PLANTING
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Hadith on planting helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS ABOUT PLANTS
Roots hold the plant and take in water. Leaves help the plant make food using sunlight.
Kenyan examples: maize, beans, sukuma wiki, bananas, mango trees.
Without water and light, most seedlings wilt.

PART 1: Read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness

What this means
In this part you learn to read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Hadith on planting” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah

What this means
In this part you learn to plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Hadith on planting matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Apply: Describe one safe action you can take related to Hadith on planting this week.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Hadith on planting is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Roots hold the plant and take in water. Leaves help the plant make food using sunlight.

Kenyan examples: maize, beans, sukuma wiki, bananas, mango trees.

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Hadith on planting” around your school. (skill: read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness)

Example 2: Say why Hadith on planting matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah)

Example 3: Describe one safe action you can take related to Hadith on planting this week. (skill: appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Hadith on planting to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness.
3. Practise this skill: plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Hadith on planting from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on planting: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Hadith on planting?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the dangers of cutting down trees?
2. What are the benefits of growing trees and crops?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Hadith on planting means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness.
5. Be able to: plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
